Autonomy interface

ProtocolLuchs Chassis Interface (LCI) v1.0: speed and steering-angle commands, live limits, odometry-grade feedback, 200 ms host heartbeat
Physical layerDedicated customer CAN 2.0B, 1 Mbit/s, big-endian
SoftwareROS 2 (Humble, Jazzy) and ROS 1 (Noetic) drivers, one code base for the Luchs family; C++ SDK, robot model, DBC files, integration guide
Units before LCI firmwareVCU interface V2.6 over CAN, supported by the same software
Chassis IMUSix-axis, 100 Hz, plus roll and pitch, on the customer CAN
External e-stop loopHard-wired loop on the payload connector

Notes

  1. All values tested by RJ Tech Limited. Modifications may be needed to meet local regulations. The product may differ from the pictures.
  2. Measured at standard tyre pressure.
  3. Other tyre sizes are available; contact your sales manager.
  4. Other steering configurations can be built to order.
  5. Creep mode: steady very-low-speed travel, tested on unpaved roads, slopes, mud, sand and rock.
  6. Power on and off by button, remote control or a scheduled time.
  7. Stealth mode switches off all lights, by remote control or by command.
  8. Humidity tested at 20–30 °C.
  9. Batteries, motors and connectors mounted below 440 mm are IP67; motor and vehicle controllers are IP65.
  10. Extended warranty available. Excludes normal wear, consumables and damage from misuse, accident or unauthorised modification; see full terms.
